meta.title: `GET /api/event_groups` requires trade read permission
gaps: The vocabulary cannot configure or identify a user with trade read permission versus one without it; buyer and vendor roles are used as proxies.

words.preconditions: A buyer signed in to the client under test (no event is built).
steps: As the buyer, list events and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).

expected.message: You are not authorized to perform this action
